## Summary
One sentence describing what this PR changes.

## Motivation
Why is this change needed? Link the issue if there is one.

## Changes
- Bullet list of concrete changes
- Keep it factual, not aspirational

## Type of change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] New script or tool
- [ ] Bug fix in existing script
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Breaking change

## Testing
How was this verified?
- [ ] Ran on a test host without errors
- [ ] shellcheck clean (for shell scripts)
- [ ] Manual smoke test described below

Describe the smoke test or paste the test output.

## Validator safety check
- [ ] No validator keys or secrets are committed
- [ ] No production endpoints are hardcoded with real credentials
- [ ] Scripts that touch chain state default to dry-run or require explicit flags

## Documentation
- [ ] README or relevant doc updated
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added under Unreleased

## Reviewer notes
Anything specific the reviewer should focus on or be careful about.
